usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the configuration of a specific SDN IPAM object by its identifier. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/ipams/{ipam}, so API tokens must have that permission granted. SDN must be enabled on the cluster; the returned object contains backend-specific fields (e.g., type, url, token) depending on whether the IPAM is netbox, phpipam, or pve.

examples.summary: Read configuration for an IPAM named 'netbox1'

tips: The ipam identifier must match the pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*[a-zA-Z0-9] (alphanumeric, start and end with a letter or digit, minimum 2 chars).
Use list_cluster_sdn_ipams first to discover valid IPAM identifiers before calling this endpoint.
Changes to SDN IPAM objects require a subsequent apply step (POST /cluster/sdn) before they take effect cluster-wide; reading with this endpoint always reflects the stored (pending) config.
